usageNotes: Permanently removes an authentication realm (e.g. LDAP, AD, OpenID Connect) from Proxmox VE. The built-in 'pve' and 'pam' realms cannot be deleted. Existing users assigned to the deleted realm will lose the ability to authenticate — consider reassigning or removing those users first.

examples.summary: Delete an LDAP authentication domain named 'corp-ldap'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the authentication realm configuration; any users bound to this realm will immediately be unable to log in.
tips: List current realms with get_access_domains before deleting to confirm the target realm ID.
Built-in realms 'pve' and 'pam' are protected and cannot be deleted via this endpoint.
Audit users assigned to the realm (get_access_users) and reassign or disable them before deletion to avoid orphaned accounts.
The operation returns null synchronously — no UPID is issued; the realm is removed immediately.
